description: This file contains React functional components for UI controls, including TextInput, PrimaryButton with loading spinner, ErrorBanner, and internal Spinner component. It defines props types, handles rendering of form inputs and buttons with styling and error display.

methods.name: TextInput
methods.description: A controlled input component with optional label and error message display, wrapped in a label element.

methods.name: Spinner
methods.description: A small SVG spinner icon used inside buttons to indicate loading state.

methods.name: PrimaryButton
methods.description: A button component that displays a loading spinner and disables itself when loading is true.

methods.name: ErrorBanner
methods.description: A styled banner component that displays an error message if provided.
